rca of the issue: Tower/room label click via Playwright pointer events: R3F's <Html> from @react-three/drei attaches an onPointerUp listener that calls releasePointerCapture(pointerId). When Playwright's synthetic click issues pointerdown+pointerup with pointerId 0 (or without pointer capture initiated), releasePointerCapture throws NotFoundError. This aborts the React onClick synthetic event before setSelected() runs. Native DOM click() (as fired by user mouse in a real browser) does not trigger the release-capture code path, so real users are unaffected.
